name: ARG and macrophage repair proposal policy and graph reachability
trigger: Inject five release-repair cases through the proposal canvas and evaluate each proposed recipe against the production R0-R4 policy before adding graph nodes.
observe: an approved proposal adds an edge from afterNodeId to the repair entry node
only a policy-approved repair is represented as executed
policy-denied repairs route to HITL and policy no-ops do not append a recipe
ledger events distinguish policy denial and policy no-op from execution
expected: Approved proposals are reachable from their prior node; denied or no-op decisions never masquerade as executed repair recipes.
